subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 492 (MP(II)-10). MT-INFO (multi-information) is the subject; CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From T-C-IMP: AF-TF (affinity transfer). From INTR: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROG-CONT: RE-DOC (redocumentation) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From AF-TF: SI (source initiation). From PROJ-DY: ATTN (attraction). From RE-DOC: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics).
